meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 启用后会同时派出 5 个审查子代理,分别核对目标与约束、检查代码质量、做安全审计、实际运行测试,并从 GitHub、Slack、Notion 等来源挖掘被忽略的上下文。只有全部通过才算通过,有一个失败就整体不通过。
howto.when: 在把工作交给别人评审(如提 PR)之前,或当你明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发,例如说“review work”“检查我的改动”等。

say.text: 帮我 review 这次的改动,我准备提 PR。
say.note: 会启动 5 个并行审查代理全面检查。

say.text: 用 review-work 核对我实现的目标和约束。
say.note: 主要核对需求和限制是否全部满足。

say.text: QA 一下我改的这部分,看看能不能跑起来。
say.note: 会实际运行应用做测试。

howto.what_en: Enables 5 parallel sub-agents to review completed work: goal/constraint checks, code quality, security audit, hands-on QA, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All must pass; any failure fails the review.
howto.when_en: Triggered before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work, e.g. saying 'review work' or 'check my changes'.

say_en.text: Review my changes — I'm about to open a PR.
Use review-work to check my implementation against the goal and constraints.
QA this part of my changes and see if it runs.
say_en.note: Runs the app hands-on for testing.
